idea-plugin.name: Minimap
idea-plugin.description:
Adds an editor Minimap: a zoomed-out overview of the whole file rendered next to the editor.

  • Bird's-eye overview of the current file with the visible viewport highlighted.
  • Click or drag on the minimap to navigate and scroll the editor instantly.
  • Overlays for selection, carets, folded regions, breakpoints, and diagnostics.
